text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan completely swept the Summer 
Sprint Series.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Commended by Chairwoman Akikawa, I even 
got a two-shot photo with her as a reward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And while teaching how to look cute in 
photos, she even managed to pitch her own 
project out of nowhere...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She even cleverly managed to snag some 
work as "Umastagrammer Curren."
